intro: Oohinchaleni Melulenno is the latest Telugu christian song written, sung by John Wesley Pakalapati and music composed by Ropp Jonathan Kati. This song was released on January 01, 2024 through JOHN WESLY CJC MINISTRIES YouTube channel.
